evals.prompt: Do a PR hygiene sweep on d-oit/do-epub-studio
evals.expected_output: Agent runs the collect subcommand of scripts/roast-batch-close.sh (dry-run-safe), fetches each candidate diff with 'gh pr diff', scores every candidate with the 0-10 impact rubric in SKILL.md, and produces the single markdown report per references/report-format.md with a per-PR decision. No PR is closed or reviewed without explicit user approval; the --execute flag is never used during the sweep.
assertions: ran the collect subcommand and used its JSON dossier (candidates + excluded)
report has an impact score for every candidate
no --execute flag was used without user approval

evals.prompt: Close the zero-impact PRs from the report
evals.expected_output: Only score <= 2 candidates that survived exclusion rules are closed, each with the close-comment template from references/report-format.md filled with the reason and impact score, invoked as 'close -R <repo> --pr N --comment-file <file>'. Excluded and draft PRs are not closed.
assertions: uses 'close --pr N --comment-file' for each zero-impact PR
close comments include the reason and impact score

evals.prompt: Review the mid-tier PRs (3-5) with change requests
evals.expected_output: One 'review --decision request-changes' per PR scored 3-5, with the review body built from the request-changes template in references/report-format.md and listing the specific required changes taken from the roast report.
assertions: uses 'review --decision request-changes' for each mid-tier PR
review bodies reference the specific blocking issues

evals.prompt: Merge the approved PRs whose report recommendations are all addressed
evals.expected_output: Only APPROVE PRs with every report recommendation addressed are passed to the merge subcommand; the merge plan orders file-independent PRs first then smallest/oldest, and each merge is preceded by the latest origin/main sync and a green-CI gate; --execute only after the user approves the merge plan.
assertions: uses merge --pr N with only approved, recommendations-addressed PRs
merge plan orders file-independent PRs before overlapping ones
each merge is preceded by syncing the PR branch to the latest origin/main
no --execute without user approval of the merge plan
